focus.title: 欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征最高38%关税，中欧磋商进入关键期
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于6月22日公布对中国产电动汽车反补贴调查初步裁定，拟对三家抽样企业加征17.4%至38%不等的额外关税。该裁定需经27个成员国表决，预计7月前生效。受影响企业可申请价格承诺谈判，但时限紧迫。中国商务部表示将采取一切必要措施维护产业利益，建议出海车企立即启动供应链与定价策略调整，并评估转移部分产能至东盟的可能性。
focus.title_en: EU Proposes Up to 38% Tariff on Chinese EVs; China-EU Talks Enter Critical Phase
focus.summary_en: On June 22, the European Commission announced preliminary anti-subsidy findings on Chinese-made electric vehicles, proposing additional tariffs ranging from 17.4% to 38% for three sampled companies. The decision requires approval by 27 member states, expected before July. Affected enterprises may apply for price undertaking negotiations but face tight deadlines. China's Ministry of Commerce vowed to take all necessary measures to safeguard industrial interests. Chinese EV exporters are advised to immediately adjust supply chains and pricing strategies, and consider relocating some production to ASEAN.

case.title: 英国高等法院认定中企在英投资仲裁案中享有“投资者”适格主体地位
case.summary: 2026年6月，英国高等法院在X公司诉英国政府投资仲裁案中裁定，依据《中英双边投资协定》及《ICSID公约》，注册于中国香港但实际控制人为内地自然人的企业，仍可被认定为“投资者”并享有条约保护。该案明确了“控制标准”在投资者国籍认定中的优先适用，为中国企业通过香港平台对英投资提供了重要判例支持。建议跨境投资架构设计时保留清晰的最终控制证据链。
case.source: 来源：英国高等法院判例 · 2026.06
case.title_en: UK High Court Rules Chinese-Controlled Hong Kong Company Qualifies as 'Investor' in BIT Arbitration
case.summary_en: In June 2026, the UK High Court held in Company X v. UK that an enterprise registered in Hong Kong but ultimately controlled by mainland Chinese individuals qualifies as an 'investor' under the China-UK Bilateral Investment Treaty and the ICSID Convention. The ruling prioritizes the 'control test' over formal nationality, providing key precedent for Chinese investments via Hong Kong platforms. Cross-border investors are advised to maintain clear evidence of ultimate control in their investment structures.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区国际商事仲裁示范规则发布，便利跨境争议解决
policy.summary: 2026年6月22日，广东省司法厅联合香港律政司、澳门法务局发布《粤港澳大湾区国际商事仲裁示范规则》，自2026年9月1日起施行。规则允许当事人自主选择仲裁地、法律及语言，并引入紧急仲裁员、第三方资助披露等国际通行制度。此举旨在统一三地仲裁程序标准，降低企业跨境争议解决成本。建议出海企业在新签涉大湾区合同时，优先约定适用该示范规则。
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Issues Model Arbitration Rules for Cross-Border Disputes
policy.summary_en: On June 22, 2026, the Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice, together with the Hong Kong Department of Justice and the Macao Legal Affairs Bureau, released the 'Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Model Arbitration Rules for International Commercial Disputes,' effective September 1, 2026. The rules allow parties to freely choose the seat, governing law, and language of arbitration, and introduce international practices such as emergency arbitrator and third-party funding disclosure. This initiative aims to harmonize arbitration procedures across the three jurisdictions and reduce dispute resolution costs. Enterprises are advised to incorporate the Model Rules into new contracts involving the Greater Bay Area.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Department of Justice · 2026.06.23

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟反补贴调查下，中国企业应提前布局“原产地穿透”合规
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟反补贴调查不仅关注产品本身，更会穿透审查供应链中原材料、零部件及组装环节的补贴情况。建议企业立即梳理上游供应商清单，识别是否存在来自中国政府的补贴（如低价供电、税收返还），并预估可能被加征的税率。同时，考虑将部分高附加值工序转移至与欧盟有自贸协定的国家（如越南、摩洛哥），以争取“原产地豁免”。英文以“Attorney Qin's view: ”开头。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Chinese Enterprises Should Proactively Address 'Origin Tracing' Compliance Amid EU Anti-Subsidy Probe
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU anti-subsidy investigation not only targets the final product but also traces subsidies in the supply chain, including raw materials, components, and assembly. Companies should immediately map their upstream suppliers to identify any Chinese government subsidies (e.g., below-market electricity, tax rebates) and estimate potential tariff exposure. Additionally, consider relocating high-value-added processes to countries with EU free trade agreements (e.g., Vietnam, Morocco) to claim 'origin exemption.'
